authored_by: independent evaluator (Claude subagent without access to the product's code or earlier sets), acting as the customer's analytics team
frozen: Written before any run of the product on it; to be committed before its first run and never edited after.
purpose: Prompt-caching trial (research candidate 5): the first 30 proof_v14 questions, plain wording, stable-prefix layout vs today. Committed before the run.
reference: Computed by eval/tiered/proof_v14_references.py from the raw tables, consistent with the customer definitions.
phrasing: The first phrasing is how an executive or analyst would ask; the second is explicit.
scoring: +1 right, 0 declined, -10 wrong; an unanswerable question that is answered counts as wrong.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: How many inpatient admissions did our hospitals have in 2027?
Count inpatient admissions at our four hospitals (one per stay, in-progress and completed versions merged) with an admit date in 2027.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What was our inpatient admission volume in 2028?
Number of inpatient stays at WH-HOSPITAL-0 to WH-HOSPITAL-3 admitted in calendar year 2028, counting each encounter once.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: How many patients did we admit as inpatients in 2029, counting admissions not people?
Count of inpatient admissions (encounters of type inpatient, one per encounter_id) at our four hospitals with admit date in 2029.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: Break down 2028 inpatient admissions by hospital.
For each of our four hospitals, the number of inpatient admissions with an admit date in 2028.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: Show our 2028 inpatient admissions by quarter.
Inpatient admissions at our four hospitals in 2028 grouped by quarter of admit date (Q1 to Q4).

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: How many distinct patients were admitted to our hospitals in 2029?
Count distinct patient_id with at least one inpatient admission at our four hospitals with admit date in 2029.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What was our average length of stay in 2027, in days?
Mean inpatient length of stay in days (discharge date minus admit date, same-day stays = 1) for discharges from our four hospitals in 2027, one decimal.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What was ALOS for 2029 in days?
Average length of stay in days over inpatient discharges at our four hospitals with discharge date in 2029, to one decimal.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: Compare average length of stay by hospital for 2028, in days.
For each of our four hospitals, mean inpatient length of stay in days for discharges in 2028, one decimal.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What share of 2028 discharges stayed six days or longer?
Share of inpatient discharges from our four hospitals in 2028 with length of stay of at least 6 days, as a share to 4 decimals.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What were the top five reasons for admission in 2029?
Top 5 ICD-10 3-character categories of the principal diagnosis on inpatient admissions at our four hospitals admitted in 2029, with counts.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: How many inpatient discharges did we have in 2028?
Count of inpatient stays at our four hospitals with a discharge date in 2028.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What share of our 2029 discharges went to a skilled nursing facility?
Among inpatient discharges at our four hospitals in 2029, the share with disposition skilled_nursing_facility, 4 decimals.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: Give me the 2028 discharge disposition breakdown.
Count of 2028 inpatient discharges at our four hospitals by disposition group (home, skilled_nursing_facility, expired, other).
What was the payer mix of our inpatient admissions in 2028?
Share of 2028 inpatient admissions at our four hospitals by the patient's line of business in member_month for the admit month (uninsured when none), 4 decimals.
How many Medicare inpatient admissions did we have in 2027?
Count of 2027 inpatient admissions at our four hospitals where the patient's member_month line of business in the admit month is medicare.
What did the ED payer mix look like in 2029?
Share of 2029 ED visits at our four hospitals by the patient's member_month line of business in the arrival month (uninsured when none), 4 decimals.
What was our 30-day readmission rate in 2027?
All-cause 30-day readmission rate: index inpatient discharges at our four hospitals in 2027 (excluding deaths) readmitted to any of the four 1-30 days after discharge / index discharges, 4 decimals.
What was the all-cause readmission rate for 2028?
Share of 2028 index discharges (inpatient, our four hospitals, not expired) followed by an inpatient admission at our hospitals within 1 to 30 days, 4 decimals.
How did our readmission rate come out in 2029?
30-day all-cause readmission rate for index discharges in 2029 at our four hospitals, by index discharge date, 4 decimals.
Show 30-day readmission rates by hospital for 2028.
For each of our four hospitals (index hospital), the 30-day all-cause readmission rate for 2028 index discharges, 4 decimals.
Break down the 2029 readmission rate by payer.
30-day all-cause readmission rate for 2029 index discharges at our four hospitals, grouped by the patient's line of business in the index admit month (uninsured when none), 4 decimals.
How many ED visits did our hospitals see in 2027?
Count of emergency department encounters (one per encounter_id, versions merged) at our four hospitals with arrival date in 2027.
What was ED volume for 2028?
Number of ED visits at WH-HOSPITAL-0 to WH-HOSPITAL-3 with arrival in 2028.
How many emergency visits did we have in 2029?
Count ED encounters at our four hospitals arriving in calendar 2029.
What was median ED length of stay in 2028, in hours?
Median time from ED arrival to departure in hours across all ED visits at our four hospitals arriving in 2028, one decimal.
How long was the typical ED visit in 2029, in hours?
Median ED arrival-to-departure time in hours for all ED visits at our four hospitals in 2029, one decimal.
For ED patients who were admitted in 2029, what was the median ED time in hours?
Median ED arrival-to-departure hours for 2029 ED visits at our four hospitals with disposition admitted or inpatient_admission, one decimal.
Median ED time in hours for treat-and-release patients in 2028?
Median ED arrival-to-departure hours for 2028 ED visits at our four hospitals not admitted and not placed in observation, one decimal.
What share of 2029 ED visits lasted six hours or more?
Share of ED visits at our four hospitals arriving in 2029 with arrival-to-departure time of at least 6 hours, 4 decimals.
